meta.name: understand-onboard
meta.description: Use when you need to generate an onboarding guide for new team members joining a project

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为新成员生成项目入职指南
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队需要快速帮助新成员了解项目
copy.tagline_en: Generate onboarding guides for new team members
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team needs to quickly help new members understand the project

howto.what: 当您要求为新成员生成入职指南时，Claude 会读取项目的知识图谱 JSON，分析项目元数据、架构层、关键文件、复杂度热点等，然后生成一份结构化的 Markdown 指南，并可选择保存到项目文件中。
howto.when: 当您需要为加入项目的新团队成员生成入职指南，或提到“生成 onboarding guide”时触发。

say.text: 请为新成员生成入职指南。
say.note: Claude 会读取项目知识图谱并生成指南。

say.text: 分析项目知识图谱，生成 onboarding 文档。
say.note: Claude 会按步骤生成 Markdown 格式的指南。

say.text: 生成项目入门指南并保存到 docs。

howto.what_en: When you ask for an onboarding guide for new team members, Claude reads the project's knowledge graph JSON, analyzes project metadata, architecture layers, key files, complexity hotspots, and generates a structured Markdown guide, optionally saving it to the project.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to generate an onboarding guide for new team members joining a project, or when you mention "generate onboarding guide".

say_en.text: Please generate an onboarding guide for new members.
say_en.note: Claude reads the knowledge graph and produces the guide.

say_en.text: Analyze the project knowledge graph and create an onboarding document.
say_en.note: Claude follows the steps to produce a Markdown guide.

say_en.text: Generate a project onboarding guide and save it.
say_en.note: Claude creates the guide and offers to save to docs/ONBOARDING.md.
